scenes.name: Hook Wall
scenes.transcript: Customers see thousands of ads every day, but most of those ads get completely ignored. We're here to change that,
scenes.visualDescription: Tilted 3D perspective grid of real AdMagic creative cards floating on a light purple radial gradient, slow drift. Word-by-word gradient kinetic type reveals 'We're here to change that,' center screen.

scenes.name: Brand Intro
scenes.transcript: introducing AdMagic — predict and improve advertising impact with AI trained on decades of neuroscience data.
scenes.visualDescription: AdMagic wordmark (white 'Ad' + green 'Magic' + sparkle) scale-reveals center screen on the purple field, subhead line types in underneath.

scenes.name: Predict
scenes.transcript: First, predict how consumers respond to your ads in seconds, get predictions on attention, engagement, memory, and more.
scenes.visualDescription: 'Upload files' white card holding eclipse-banner.png, curved connector line to 'AdMagic AI Predictions' node, branching to a Heatmap node and a red-yellow-green Neural Score gauge sweeping to 58.

scenes.name: Insights Generate
scenes.transcript: Then, get guided insights into what works and what doesn't to help you make them more compelling in a few clicks. Finally, generate visual recommendations that automatically maximize attention, engagement, and memorability.
scenes.visualDescription: Dark prompt card types a live edit instruction, arrow feeds into design-before.jpg then design-after.png, each stamped with a score badge (58 -> 84, +26 pill), small version-history thumbnails stack on the side.

scenes.name: The Loop
scenes.visualDescription: Circular diagram, 3 icon nodes (brain / lightbulb / sparkle) orbiting the AdMagic mark; design-before.jpg flows in left as 'Asset', design-after.png flows out right as 'Optimized Asset' with a green checkmark.

scenes.name: Capability Stat
scenes.transcript: 100+ brands, agencies, and marketers are already on the waitlist (rewritten from reference's unrelated 30%/95% stats, using real AdMagic data)
scenes.visualDescription: Billboard stat card, light background, giant gradient '100+', subtitle 'already on the AdMagic waitlist', three pill chips fan in: D2C Brand Owners / Agencies / Marketers & Founders.

scenes.name: Closing Wall
scenes.transcript: Join over 500 brands across the globe and reduce wasted ad spend with confidence. Start improving your ads today. (rewritten CTA, no fabricated brand count)
scenes.visualDescription: Same tilted card wall from Hook Wall returns, blurs, centered pill button 'Start Your Trial' fades up.
